acceptance.diagnostic_failure: retain and classify; not an execution failure
acceptance.missing_seed: retain failure; no silent replacement; complete-cohort summary unavailable; any available-case summary labelled descriptive
acceptance.numerical_failure: preserve partial record, stop without algorithmic repair; no clipping unprojected critic
acceptance.solver_failure: retain policy/run; exact evaluation invalid pending numerical repair under unchanged tolerances; no substitution of reference values

diagnostics.biological_null_reason: No exact finite-reset compact-feature gradient; continuing diagnostic not applicable
diagnostics.unavailable_values: JSON null with explicit reason; no NaN or fabricated zero

identity.execution_receipt: separate later authorization/preflight bound to protocol digest and actual implementation/source/input/environment hashes; do not edit locked configs
identity.scientific_payload: study + common + analysis + record_contract + full source SHA-256 index; ignore no keys

numerical_environment.bit_generator: PCG64 with NumPy SeedSequence; full state and version stored

dtype_policy.save_precision: lossless arrays and full-precision JSON numbers

numerical_environment.versions: record actual installed versions and compare with frozen versions before fixed_configuration/fixed_configuration; no cross-hardware bitwise guarantee

operational.interruption_not_failure: external interruption resumes same scientific path after exact prefix/state verification; no duplicate update accounting
operational.nonfinite_guard: fail immediately and preserve previous finite checkpoint plus offending input
operational.pause_policy: pause only after an atomic complete-hold or complete-episode checkpoint; preserve attempts and exact resume state; wall time cannot select an endpoint
operational.pilot_scope_later: isolated correctness/runtime probes only; never select gains, seeds or horizon from performance
operational.retry_policy: same protocol/seed/state only for external interruption; implementation bug requires preserved failure and explicit amendment
operational.safety_action: save finite pre-failure state, mark numerical_safety_failure, stop; no automatic restart with changed gains or rescaling

serialization.arrays: lossless NPY/NPZ with allow_pickle=False, explicit dtype/shape/order
serialization.event_identity: unique cohort/run/attempt/decision or episode identifier; attempts are not seeds
serialization.hash: SHA-256 raw files and logical contiguous arrays, name/dtype/shape also recorded
serialization.json: UTF-8 sort_keys, full binary64 round-trip values, allow_nan=False
serialization.snapshots: record all RNG states, next unconsumed draw offsets, source/config digests and optimizer/counter state
serialization.transaction: write temporary file, flush, atomically replace only new checkpoint name; manifest written last

statistics.bootstrap: percentile bootstrap resampling whole training-seed blocks with replacement; use same indices for paired within-study contrasts
statistics.exact_reference_uncertainty: none; numerical solver residuals, not sampling error
statistics.feasibility: flag each seed and displayed aggregate against declared tolerance; separately report fraction of feasible training seeds; no confidence guarantee
statistics.finite_horizon_rate: sum(K)/sum(T) within a seed; T=H in persistent-horizon studies
statistics.first_arrival_rate: sum(K)/sum(T_cap), including zero/zero initially targeted episodes in totals, not as per-episode ratios
statistics.fixed_first_arrival_bootstrap: resample within each initial-state stratum, preserve equal state weights; do not randomize the stratified initial distribution
statistics.fixed_policy_uncertainty: rollout population SD ddof=0, plus separately labelled rollout-bootstrap mean interval; not a trained-seed SD
statistics.learned_primary_unit: independently trained policy/run label; nested rollouts are not extra training replications
statistics.quantile: linear interpolation h=(n-1)*q, between adjacent sorted values
statistics.rate_across_seeds: mean of seedwise ratios; separately retain pooled ratio of all totals, do not conflate
statistics.sd: sample SD with ddof=1 across seedwise estimates
statistics.zero_denominator: null with explicit reason, never 0/0=0 or NaN

timing.include: record hardware model, logical/physical cores, RAM, OS, Python/package versions, accelerator use, determinism flags, process isolation and source commit/hash
timing.profile: CPU-only sequential workers; torch and BLAS threads=1; record all effective thread settings
timing.reruns: Do not repeat timings and retain only favorable ones. Any timed repetition plan requires a versioned config.
